title: Fair Labor Standards Act of 1938
verified_how: Fetched govinfo USCODE-2024 29 U.S.C. 201. Its heading is 'Short title' and the statutory text reads 'This chapter may be cited as the "Fair Labor Standards Act of 1938"'. Also fetched 29 U.S.C. 206 (Minimum wage), which is live text current through 6 January 2025.
notes: Covers minimum wage, overtime and recordkeeping. Many states set higher minimum wages and add their own wage-payment laws, which the FLSA does not preempt.
